title: High Quality Genomic DNA Extraction From Gram-Positive Bacteria
author: G-Biosciences
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.e57bg9n
materials: Allow the sample to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Pellet bacteria cells
steps.instruction: Aliquot 0.5 ml overnight Gram‑positive bacterial culture into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube and centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in water and EDTA
steps.instruction: Add 450 µl sterile water and 50 µl EDTA to the pellet, then gently vortex to resuspend.

steps.title: Lysozyme treatment
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl Longlife™ Lysozyme, invert to mix, and incubate at 37 °C for 45 minutes with periodic mixing.

steps.title: Heat incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample at 55–60 °C for 15 minutes; do not exceed 60 °C.

steps.title: Optional Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: (Optional) Add 1 µl Proteinase K per 100 µl Lysis Buffer, then incubate at 60 °C for 1–2 hours, inverting the tube periodically each hour.

steps.title: Chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl chloroform and mix by inverting the tube several times.

steps.title: Phase separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 10 minutes, then carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to a clean microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: DNA stripping
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl DNA Stripping Solution and invert several times to mix.

steps.title: Heat DNA stripping
steps.instruction: Incubate at 60 °C for 5–10 minutes.

steps.title: Precipitation solution addition
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl Precipitation Solution, invert several times; if a white precipitate does not form, add 50 µl additional Precipitation Solution aliquots until it appears.

steps.title: Precipitate centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a clean tube, add 500 µl isopropanol, and invert the tube 10 times to precipitate DNA. (Optional) Add 2 µl Mussel Glycogen as a DNA carrier.

steps.title: DNA pellet collection
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 5 minutes to pellet genomic DNA, then remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 700 µl 70 % ethanol, invert several times to wash the pellet, then centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Ethanol removal
steps.instruction: Decant or pipette off the ethanol wash.

steps.title: Dry pellet
steps.instruction: Invert the tube on a clean absorbent surface for several minutes to allow excess ethanol to drain; do not let the pellet dry completely.

steps.title: Resuspend in TE
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl TE buffer to the pellet.

steps.title: Rehydrate DNA
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for at least 15 minutes to rehydrate (or 5–60 minutes at 55–60 °C to speed up). (Optional) Add 1 µl LongLife™ RNase per 100 µl TE buffer.

steps.title: DNA storage
steps.instruction: Store DNA at 4 °C for short‑term; for long‑term storage keep at –20 °C or –80 °C. Typical yield 25–50 µg per ml of Gram‑positive culture.

steps.title: Post‑extraction cleanup – centrifuge
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 5 minutes and pour off the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet
steps.instruction: Gently vortex the tube to resuspend the pellet in the residual liquid.

steps.title: Genomic Lysis Buffer addition
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl Genomic Lysis Buffer and mix by inverting the tube several times; do not vortex.
